description: List all tracked mobile applications. Returns each app with its store metadata: title, description, app_id (bundle ID), store (ITUNES or GPLAY), country, lang (BCP-47), icon URL, screenshots, developer name, genre, version, rating score, number of ratings, the count of tracked keywords, and aso_health (the listing audit: global score plus its coverage, targeting and appeal axes, or null on an app the audit has not reached yet; get_aso_health returns the breakdown behind it). Usually the first call of a workflow: the numeric internal ID it returns is what track_keywords, add_competitor, get_app_score_history and the other app-scoped tools expect, whereas add_application takes the store bundle ID instead. Read-only.

app_id.description: Filter by application internal ID (numeric, e.g. "344")

name: list_applications
